![HPHT Vs CVD Lab Grown Diamonds: Key Differences](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-ddf0ad379f3b:4)
CVD diamonds are a specific type of lab-grown diamond created using a [Chemical Vapor Deposition](https://www.miadonna.com/blogs/news/comparing-cvd-and-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-which-is-better) method, meaning there is no "versus" between them because a CVD diamond *is* a lab-grown diamond.[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/blogs/news/comparing-cvd-and-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-which-is-better)

The broader category is lab-grown diamonds, which are produced in laboratories using advanced technology. They are optically, physically, and chemically identical to mined diamonds. Within lab-grown diamonds, there are two primary creation methods: **CVD** and **HPHT** (High Pressure High Temperature).[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/blogs/news/comparing-cvd-and-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-which-is-better)

### Understanding CVD vs. HPHT Lab-Grown Diamonds

- **CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition):** Uses a vacuum chamber filled with carbon-rich gas heated into plasma. Carbon atoms deposit layer by layer onto a diamond seed. This method often yields very high clarity and colorless results.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[2]](https://kingjewelers.com/blogs/editorial/lab-grown-diamonds-a-modern-marvel-of-technology-and-sustainability)
- **HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature):** Recreates the intense heat and pressure found deep within the earth. Carbon melts and crystallizes around a seed. This older method can sometimes result in minor metallic inclusions or a slight blue/yellow hue.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)
- **Appearance:** Both CVD and HPHT stones look completely identical to the naked eye and to natural diamonds.[[1]](https://lgdusallc.com/blog-details/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds)[[2]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)
- **Testing:** Both test positive as real diamonds on standard diamond testers.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)

Learn more about the technical differences between these growing techniques in this video:
